messages.text: Two VC-200 Rev B units at Kaveri browned out on a cold morning restart. Logged as SUP-1042. Is that the power-good timing again?
Looks like it. Rev B still runs firmware 2.2, which waits only 4 ms for power-good. pmic_seq.c in 2.3 waits 6 ms, tuned to the NB54360 soft-start (FW-233). I'll push 2.3.1 to the Kaveri units.
2.3.1 is on all 220 Kaveri Rev B units. No brownouts since. Folding the cold-start test into the Firmware 2.4 release so it stays covered.
Added a -20C cold-start step to TP-PSU-07 so any regulator change also re-checks power sequencing.
